reviews.comment: He's an amazing instructor and a very experienced engineer. While the classes were tough and his lectures could be better, he made that up by giving us his insight whenever I had questions and his advice was always insightful and helpful. This man has made my passion for Engineering even greater, and I am honored and proud to have him.

Not bad at all looking back. He is a great guy and a good teacher but the lectures are kind of pointless. Lectures are just slideshows and would be better if he worked out problems by hand. Labs are easy looking back and he will help you and extend due dates often and is typically always free. Refer to the slideshow for work and study the homework.
